basePrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished realistic desktop design reference for DEPTH AI, a visual code explorer. Wide landscape desktop screenshot, modern readable sans serif, crisp controls. NEW COMPOSITION, never four equal quadrants.

MOST IMPORTANT: This is a USER-RECONFIGURABLE DOCKING EDITOR, like the panel behavior of Unity or an IDE, not a fixed dashboard. Each panel has a compact draggable TAB with a grip and a close/menu icon. Thin draggable splitters, tab groups and a "Layout: Custom" dropdown plus Reset in the top toolbar communicate that users can move, dock, group, resize, collapse and maximize panels.

DEFAULT WORKSPACE:
Preview takes the LEFT 57% of available width and about 86% of available height. It must be by far the biggest visual region. Under the preview there is ONLY a SHORT BOTTOM DOCK about 110 pixels tall in a 1000px-high image (around 11% total height), containing small TABS "Console" and "Meta CLI". Console active. Show only 2 short neutral lines and a command input. This is a tiny utility shelf, not a large quadrant. No chat transcript occupying a quarter of the screen.
On the RIGHT 43% of width, a large Module canvas takes the upper roughly 72% of window height. A compact Hierarchy pane below it takes about 21% of window height. Its horizontal splitter MUST be visibly HIGHER than the console splitter on the left: asymmetric staggered division, not aligned 2x2.
No permanent sidebar or giant page heading. There are three dominant sized areas: enormous preview, large module canvas, small hierarchy; console is only a narrow bottom utility dock. Leave ample space for main work.

Top thin toolbar: "DEPTH AI | Checkout", "Inspect Explain Transform Assets Review", Light/Dark, "Layout: Custom", Reset.
Preview pane draggable tab "Project preview" plus maximize icon. White actual checkout app with ceramic mug48, plant72, subtotal120, discount24, selected total96 and coupon entry. Large spacious preview, not a tiny embedded screenshot. Selected total outlined orange.
Module pane draggable tab "Modules", Fit and zoom controls; slate-blue drafting surface; several open owner brackets and distinct chamfered function plates / cylindrical state objects. Include ApplyCoupon, IsValid, CalculateTotal selected orange, DiscountPercent20, SetTotal, Read, Estimate. Owner labels CheckoutController, CouponValidator, CouponRules, CartState, TotalsView, CartSummary. Selected dependency only: ApplyCoupon -> CalculateTotal, Estimate -> CalculateTotal, CalculateTotal -> DiscountPercent. Lines through whitespace. Fine small caption "Selected links". Keep other nodes visible.
Hierarchy pane draggable tab "Hierarchy", compact search box "Find module...", densely readable tree with CheckoutController.cs, CouponRules.cs expanded to CalculateTotal and DiscountPercent, CartState.cs, plus a small Recent list. This is a navigation utility, not an enormous fourth quarter.
Bottom-left short Console/Meta CLI tab dock: dark graphite terminal, text exactly "> inspect Total" and "source: CouponRules.cs", bottom prompt ">". A collapse-chevron in its header. No green checks or invented test outputs. The Meta CLI is an independent movable tab in the same short dock, not merged permanently into the Console panel.
One unobtrusive footer label "DESIGN REFERENCE". DO NOT overlay instructional callouts or large explanatory labels. Show a practical usable app screen. The docked UI and asymmetric proportions are essential.
